definitions.explanation: Someone accepted into a program that trains them for a specific post, and who will take up that post once training is complete. From {候補|こうほ} (candidacy) + {生|せい} (student). Almost always used with a preceding word naming the post: {幹部候補生|かんぶこうほせい}, {宇宙飛行士候補生|うちゅうひこうしこうほせい}.

examples.japanese: {兄|あに}は{幹部候補生|かんぶこうほせい}として{採用|さいよう}された。
examples.english: My older brother was hired as a management trainee.

examples.japanese: {候補生|こうほせい}は{三年間|さんねんかん}の{訓練|くんれん}を{受|う}ける。
examples.english: Cadets undergo three years of training.

examples.japanese: {宇宙飛行士候補生|うちゅうひこうしこうほせい}に{選|えら}ばれたのは{十人|じゅうにん}だけだった。
examples.english: Only ten people were chosen as astronaut candidates.

examples.japanese: {候補生|こうほせい}のうちに{現場|げんば}を{一通|ひととお}り{経験|けいけん}させるのが、この{会社|かいしゃ}の{方針|ほうしん}だ。
examples.english: It's this company's policy to have trainees experience every part of the workplace while they are still in training.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
- {幹部候補生|かんぶこうほせい}: management trainee (a common hiring track at Japanese companies)
- {自衛官候補生|じえいかんこうほせい}: Self-Defense Force recruit
- {宇宙飛行士候補生|うちゅうひこうしこうほせい}: astronaut candidate
- {候補生|こうほせい}{時代|じだい}: one's days as a trainee

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {研修生|けんしゅうせい}: trainee — someone receiving training, with no promise of a particular post afterward
- {見習|みなら}い: apprentice — learning a trade by watching and assisting, often manual work
- {新人|しんじん}: newcomer, rookie — already in the job, just new to it
